title: India: Iron ore sales of over 360,000 t recorded in NMDC and Vedanta auctions from Karnataka
dek: Iron ore auctions held by NMDC and Vedanta in Karnataka recorded sales of over 360,000 t, according to BigMint.
summary: BigMint reports that iron ore sales of over 360,000 t were recorded in auctions conducted by NMDC and Vedanta from Karnataka. The publisher's excerpt does not give prices, grades or the split between the two sellers.
keyFacts: Iron ore sales of over 360,000 t recorded
Auctions held by NMDC and Vedanta
whyItMatters: Karnataka auction volumes are a useful gauge of merchant iron ore demand among south Indian steelmakers and pellet producers.
implications: Buyers and traders would want the price outcomes, which the headline does not provide, to judge whether domestic ore costs are firming or easing.
